description:
Posting modified to compete small businesses.

This is a Brand Name requirement for Modicon M580 Programmable Logic Controlle (PLC) Equipment.

This procurement is set aside for small business.

 All correspondence should reference Notice ID 80NSSC26929072Q in the subject line.

NOTE: The distributor shall be Authorized/Certified through the Schneider Electric Alliance Industrial Automation Distributor (IAD) program. Verification in SE’s IAD and verification as an authorized distributor can be confirmed at           https://www.se.com/us/en/partners/distributors/industrial-automation/.

See attachments for complete details for the RFQ, Statement of Work, and Redacted Brand Name Justification.
